race.comment: SHOW THE WAY (5) is the horse to beat after making it two wins from two runs this campaign, both at this track, and his latest nose defeat of Cheyne Bay came as favourite after he travelled well and finished over the top. Trending the right way and can bring up the hat-trick. RANDOM REWARDS (8) is the key danger off stronger Saturday company form, having been beaten just over four lengths in a 1MW at Belmont after a fourth in the same grade. She's better than she showed last start and coming back to this level can see her recapture her best form. QUEEN ARIA (7) has a reliable profile, made solid inroads first-up at Bunbury and brings a strong track record with Pike back aboard. BUSTER BIFF (4) resumes from a Listed J.C. Roberts Stakes run and had won an Open at Belmont the start prior, with two trials helping his readiness for an untried 1400m fresh assignment. SPANGLEDSTAR (12) can resume on a positive note, albeit he is better over further.
